observations: IPC peer pointers feed local copy buffers.
Two buffers protect read-after-write and overwrite dependencies.
NVFP4 weight view combines local and staged weights.
VA-based facade delegates prefetch and weight binding.
Peer slices are copied to local remote-region buffers.
Optional cudaMemcpyBatchAsync plan uses interleaved slices.
Compute waits for prefetch, then protects the buffer through consumption.
Local VA region maps its resident handle.
Remote VA regions are page-pool copy targets, not direct remote GEMM operands.
Rejects registered layers without the expected expert module.

accounting.worker_remote_formula: R*(1-1/P)*L*66 MiB per worker batch without remote retention
staging_examples: Two complete remote MLP layers: 132 MiB.
limits: One batch shares each weight transfer across ready rows.
A cache can reduce refetches but consumes HBM.
Count each wire byte once, even though source and destination both process it.
No advertised-bandwidth latency or speedup estimate.

transfer_contract.staged_weights: Source read, link transfer, destination write, local GEMM read, and buffer ordering.
transfer_contract.dense_layout_gap: Dense TP shards do not necessarily match expert-block contiguity. Charge compatible views or packing.
transfer_contract.direct_peer_GEMM: Can avoid complete staging. Still needs remote operand service, valid mappings, and kernel qualification.
transfer_contract.compute_owner: Both activation directions plus queue, packing, compute and complete-return dependency.
transfer_contract.recurrence: Unique physical weights are not four copies. Retaining every remote weight restores local replication.
transfer_contract.readiness: Future immutable weights can prefetch before hidden states. Future dense compute still needs exact prior hidden/KV.
transfer_contract.adaptive: Charge prefetched unused later-pass weights and preserve original gates and depth-indexed KV.
transfer_contract.baseline: Same-P native async TP and generic DP/AFD/TSP/dense weight-sharing controls with aliased unrolling.
transfer_contract.prior_remote_MLP_limit: The tested activation round trip does not reject every remote-weight layout.
